headline: 10 development projects involving Tk24,110cr get Ecnec nod
summary: Bangladesh's Executive Committee of the National Economic Council approved 10 development projects worth Tk24,110 crore. Funding includes Tk12,775.99 crore from government funds and Tk8,944.21 crore from project loans.
why: The Ecnec approves state development spending, which shapes public investment and infrastructure contracts in Bangladesh.
